steps.rationale: Exclusive slot: at most one scout run per user may be in flight (race-proven), and the database enforces it — this step shares its slot with nothing. Makes no model call, so it reserves no paid run.

Runs in order on the application spine; a refusal here ends the chain. Scheduled after scout — its input is produced by them. One dispatch accounts for 3 catalog cards (matchScoring, atsOptimization, skillGap) — they share a backend, so running them separately would bill the same work more than once. Makes no model call, so it reserves no paid run. Starts 5s after the previous step.

notes: Concurrency ceiling 1: no more than 1 step(s) are ever in flight, whatever a step's class permits.
Steps are spaced 5s apart so a plan cannot saturate the worker.
Budget is reserved per step at dispatch and refunded on an honest failure — the plan never pre-reserves work it may not perform.
19 dispatch(es) account for 21 catalog card(s); cards that share a backend are covered by one run, not billed twice.
A silo step holds an exclusive slot enforced by the database, not by a disabled button.
